style.styleTitle: Scottish Everlastings Ltd Artificial Pre-lit Frosted Christmas Wreath
style.toneOfVoice: Welcome the season with the serene beauty of this 45cm pre-lit frosted wreath, delicately dusted with a snowy finish and softened by the velvety touch of lamb’s ear foliage. This timeless piece combines frosted greenery with warm white LED lights, creating a cosy, inviting glow perfect for any doorway, mantel, or wall. Designed to bring a peaceful, wintry charm to your home, this wreath blends rustic style with a hint of sophistication—no wilting, no mess, just everlasting beauty. Subtle, elegant, and endlessly versatile—make this wreath your new winter favourite. 2x AA batteries required. Batteries not included. Matching items available. Wreath width: D45cm. Recommended for indoor use only. Size : ONE.
